patterns.note: Asymmetrical layout with large, expressive typographic elements serving as visual anchors, contrasting with a structured grid for portfolio items.
Extreme typographic contrast between a highly distinctive, playful display font and a clean, modern sans-serif for body and navigation text.
Bold, high-contrast color palette featuring a vibrant accent green against a shifting background of purple, light grey, and dark charcoal.

The global navigation bar sticks to the top and dynamically changes its background from transparent to solid dark, and its text color from dark to light, as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
The page background color transitions dramatically between sections (purple to light grey to dark charcoal) as the user scrolls, creating distinct visual zones.
The hero section features oversized, custom typography that scrolls with the page content, rather than remaining fixed or parallaxing.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header navigation that changes its background color and text color based on scroll position, likely triggered by reaching a certain scroll depth or intersecting with specific page sections.
Create full-page background color transitions that are tied to scroll progress, allowing the page's dominant color to shift smoothly between predefined section colors.
Utilize custom, large-scale typography as primary visual elements within the page's content flow, ensuring they scroll naturally with the page rather than being fixed or animated independently.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, custom display headings (~5-10x body) with a playful, rounded character, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Pill-shaped for interactive elements like buttons and badges, with subtle rounding on image cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in the hero and main content sections, becoming more dense within the portfolio grid.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, custom typography that acts as a primary visual element, integrated directly into the scrolling content. This, combined with dramatic full-page background color shifts on scroll, creates a highly dynamic and memorable browsing experience that feels more like an interactive art piece than a standard portfolio.
